final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT c.constructorId, c.nationality, COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) as standing_count FROM constructors c LEFT JOIN constructorStandings cs ON c.constructorId = cs.constructorId GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.nationality), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(standing_count) as avg_standing_count FROM step1) SELECT s1.constructorId, s1.nationality, s1.standing_count, s1.standing_count - s2.avg_standing_count as difference FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2 WHERE s2.avg_standing_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
